770 words including LaTeX commands. Rendered prose is ~620 words, on target. No em-dashes, no en-dashes, no -ing phrase endings, no blacklisted words. All style checks pass.

Written to `docs/paper/sections/experimental_setup.tex`. The section covers three subsections:

1. **ACIS Importance Scorer** (3.46M params / 0.77%, Stage-1-only frozen-expert training, importance margin loss)
2. **Ablation Design** (three axes with explicit failure hypotheses each rules out, six conditions + baseline)
3. **Evaluation Protocol** (500 episodes per suite, bypass mode baseline, Wilson 95% CI with concrete examples)

Cross-references link back to Background (Section 2) for architecture/LIBERO details and forward to Experiments (Table 1) for results. ACIS is defined on first use. No content duplicated from Background.
